members.name: Sri Balaji Chits
members.notes: Foreman's ticket. Takes month one at the floor, as the chit agreement says.

members.name: Revathi Sundaram
members.notes: I want to buy a computerised embroidery machine before wedding season. Month 3 or 4 is ideal, month 2 is fine too. The machine costs about ₹3.8 lakh, so anything above ₹3.7 lakh in hand works for me. Do not give away more than a quarter of the chit for it.

members.name: Imran Shaikh
members.notes: Diwali stocking is in month 4 or 5. I earn well on that stock, so I can give up to 30% if I must, but try not to. Before month 3 I have no use for the money.

members.name: Kamala Devi
members.notes: I joined this chit to save. I do not want the money early. Never bid for me; I will take whatever comes at the end.

members.name: Suresh Babu
members.notes: I would like to add a second kitchen, but only if the money is cheap. If last month's pot went above 15% I am not interested. My limit is 14%.

members.name: Fatima Begum
members.notes: My daughter's college fee is due in month 7. I need the pot in month 6, 7 or 8, not before. Up to 20% is acceptable; the bank quoted me 16% a year for a loan and this is simpler.

members.name: Rajan Pillai
members.notes: If nobody else wants it I will take it any month and buy a lift for the garage. But I will not pay more than 12%.

members.name: Meena Krishnan
members.notes: URGENT: the deposit on my new shop is due next month (month 2). I must have the pot in month 2, even at 35%. After month 2 I do not need it at all.

members.name: Dinesh Kumar
members.notes: I am saving for a new machine next year. I would take the pot only at the floor discount, never a paisa more.

members.name: Priya Nair
members.notes: I want a deck oven, ideally month 5 (orders pick up from month 6). Months 4 to 6 are fine. I can give up to 18%.

draws.minutes:
MINUTES OF THE PROCEEDINGS OF THE DRAW
Lakshmi Nagar Traders' Chit — instalment 1 of 10
Date: 14 October 2026. Conducted electronically; subscribers represented by their authorised agents.

Gross chit amount: ₹5,00,000. Instalment: ₹50,000. Foreman's commission: 5% (₹25,000). Ceiling on discount: 40% (₹2,00,000).
All subscribers paid up; all unprized subscribers eligible to bid.

The foreman took the first instalment's pot at the floor discount, as provided in the chit agreement.

RESULT: Prized subscriber Sri Balaji Chits. Discount ₹25,000 (5%). Net chit amount paid to the prized subscriber: ₹4,75,000. Foreman's commission: ₹25,000. Share of discount to every ticket: ₹0, credited against the next instalment.

Recorded by FOREMAN from the figures that moved on Razorpay. Section references: Chit Funds Act, 1982, ss. 6, 21, 22.

MINUTES OF THE PROCEEDINGS OF THE DRAW
Lakshmi Nagar Traders' Chit — instalment 2 of 10
Date: 14 October 2026. Conducted electronically; subscribers represented by their authorised agents.

Gross chit amount: ₹5,00,000. Instalment: ₹50,000. Foreman's commission: 5% (₹25,000). Ceiling on discount: 40% (₹2,00,000).
All subscribers paid up; all unprized subscribers eligible to bid.

Bids received (largest discount each subscriber offered):
  Fatima Begum: did not bid
  Imran Shaikh: did not bid
  Rajan Pillai: 5%
  Suresh Babu: 14%
  Kamala Devi: did not bid
  Revathi Sundaram: 25%
  Meena Krishnan: 35%
  Dinesh Kumar: 5%
  Priya Nair: did not bid

The highest offer was Meena Krishnan's. The discount was settled at one increment (0.5%) above the next offer.

RESULT: Prized subscriber Meena Krishnan. Discount ₹1,27,500 (25.5%). Net chit amount paid to the prized subscriber: ₹3,72,500. Foreman's commission: ₹25,000. Share of discount to every ticket: ₹10,250, credited against the next instalment.

Recorded by FOREMAN from the figures that moved on Razorpay. Section references: Chit Funds Act, 1982, ss. 6, 21, 22.
